summary: MPI_Wtime bounds timing at 0xcb00–0xcc3f. The compiled per-iteration path increments at 0xcbb7, compares against the requested count at 0xcbc4, and returns to loop entry 0xcb50. The two sm_86 bodies cover all assigned local rows and each CSR interval, with warp reduction in the warp variant.
